role.title: Field Support Technician
role.location: Awka, Anambra State (fibre and fixed-wireless customers across Awka)
role.summary: You install and repair the last mile: aerial fibre drops, drop boxes, ONUs and Wi-Fi at homes and businesses, and Cambium radios where fibre does not reach. You work in a team of two or three with a lead, on a daily list, and every job ends with a measured result and a report.

levels.name: Trainee
levels.who: Little or no field experience, strong on the aptitude test; learns the core skills on probation.

levels.name: Technician
levels.who: Can do the core fibre and radio work alone on a normal job; strong on both the aptitude and the domain test.

levels.name: Senior
levels.who: Leads a crew, troubleshoots boxes and feeders, teaches; rated 4–5 on the advanced lines.

must_haves: Able to work at height on ladders and poles
Available six days a week including Sundays, with call-outs
A valid means of identification (NIN, voter's card, driver's licence or passport)
nice_to_haves: BSc/HND in Electrical Engineering or telecoms.

process.text: Fill in a few details and confirm your phone with a one-time code. You can stop after any section of the skills inventory and continue later.
About 100 short 'Can you…' questions, rated 1 to 5. Be honest — it is checked against the test and the trial day.
45 minutes: reasoning, numbers and detail, some field questions, and what you would do in real situations.
Ten minutes with our team lead.
Half a day at our bench and practice pole doing the real work.
A written offer, a guarantor form and ID check, then probation with clear targets.

scale.label: Never done it
scale.text: I could not do it if asked today.

scale.label: Watched or helped
scale.text: I have seen it done or helped, but I could not do it alone yet.

scale.label: Can do it alone
scale.text: I can do it by myself on a normal job.

scale.label: Can do it when it is hard
scale.text: I can do it alone even when it is difficult, and I can fix it when it goes wrong.

scale.label: Others come to me
scale.text: I am the person others call for this. I can teach it and I set the standard.

parts: reasoning, numbers and attention to detail
